verses.english: “There are, mendicants, these two kinds of happiness.
Happiness of the flesh and happiness not of the flesh.
These are the two kinds of happiness.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ sukhānaṁ yadidaṁ nirāmisaṁ sukhan”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of happiness is happiness not of the flesh.”
